monitored_text: Resources Design Guides Design Guide: Sheet Metal Fabrication Design Guide: Sheet Metal Fabrication Use our free guide to learn how to optimize your designs for sheet metal fabrication by following our best practices for key design elements, including bend radii, feature spacing, material selection, and more. Download the Guide Optimizing custom part designs for sheet metal fabrication requires careful consideration of various factors. These include material inputs, general tolerancing, finishes, bend dimensions and radii, inserts, welding, and more. We've compiled our best design tips into this guide to help you understand the sheet metal fabrication process, key design considerations for optimizing your parts for manufacturing, and Xometry's sheet metal services.
